contract.application_relevance: Keep mutable application metadata objects separate from stored record annotations.

cleanup.finally: Attempt each owned-name delete independently, then bulk-get the exact owned names and require a Map containing only null values. This verifies logical row cleanup only.
cleanup.on_cleanup_failure: FAIL; record error and preserve adapter evidence. Do not report success.
cleanup.on_external_timeout: Adapter stops only its owned invocation/process group when necessary and discards its disposable store after collecting evidence; namespace state is indeterminate until then.
cleanup.preflight: Sequentially delete only statically declared owned names in the fresh disposable namespaces.
cleanup.teardown: After the wave, stop only the adapter-owned celld process group and discard its fresh disposable store. K219 can leave an armed expiration alarm because neither nonexpiring replacement nor delete calls _rearm; null bulk gets do not prove alarm disarm.

contract.distinctness: Targets metadata serialization snapshots rather than K208 replacement or K209 field-presence semantics.
fixed_finite_trace: Call put with nested metadata and mutate the input before awaiting.
Get metadata and compare to original; mutate returned metadata.
Get metadata again and list the record.

assertions: input mutation does not change stored metadata
read mutation does not change later metadata
oracle.claim: put JSON.stringify runs before the awaited RPC; subsequent reads and list independently JSON.parse stored metadata.
oracle.freshness_qualification: All read-after-write/delete results pin this exact source behavior. They are not a universal Cloudflare or future celld freshness promise; kv.js lines 8-13 deliberately promise weak consistency.

contract.overlap_audit: overlap-audit.json; no runtime-credit or recovered-prior-KV attribution

schedule.ordering: Await every listed operation in order except K203/K207 local mutation before awaiting their single put, and K220 explicit Promise.all groups.
